Partly built

Neighbourhood errand

A small errand will be posted with a hold and an acceptance window; a neighbour will take it, and there will never be a fee on free work.

Partly built. Some of the steps below exist today and the rest are still to come. The lists at the bottom show which.

How it runs

  1. GoalYou no tool neededAsk for a small job: pick up, fix, lend.
  2. PlanThe match via person outsideShows the job to people nearby, by distance band.
  3. ProposalA neighbour no tool neededAccepts inside the window.
  4. ReceiptThe job via a personDone and confirmed.
What you get
Starts withA neighbour
StatusPartly built
The errand, who did it, and anything paid.

What it keeps to

  • Distance is a band, never a location.
  • No fee is taken on work that is free.
